task.summary: Fix nested bold and dim formatting so closing a dim segment inside an outer bold segment resumes the surrounding bold style instead of dropping it. Preserve existing nested-color behavior.

args: process.env.FORCE_COLOR='1';try{const{pathToFileURL}=await import('node:url');const{resolve}=await import('node:path');const colors=await import(pathToFileURL(resolve('index.js')).href);const actual=`Hello ${colors.dim('world')}, ${colors.bold(`are ${colors.dim('you')} ok`)}?`;const expected='Hello \u001B[2mworld\u001B[22m, \u001B[1mare \u001B[2myou\u001B[22m\u001B[1m ok\u001B[22m?';process.exitCode=actual===expected?0:1}catch{process.exitCode=1}
